name: quickbooks-bridge
notes: QBO only. QuickBooks Desktop is a separate Tier 3 adapter. Token refresh job required — refresh_token expires in 100 days. Set QUICKBOOKS_SANDBOX_MODE=true for non-production testing. PRODUCTION IS READ-ONLY / MIRROR-ONLY (PEC-98 / docs/74): QUICKBOOKS_ACCESS_MODE=read_only and QUICKBOOKS_WRITE_ENABLED=false. Use read-only-client.mjs for all agent/sync pulls.
